data.one_liner: A Flutter package to display currency flags using standard image assets.
data.what_it_does: Provides currency flag icons as image assets. Allows displaying a currency flag by specifying the currency name when creating a new Image widget.
use_when: You need to display currency flag icons in your Flutter application
You want a simple asset-based approach for currency symbols or flags
avoid_when: You need dynamic vector-based currency symbols rather than raster images
You need extensive financial calculations or currency conversion tools
strengths: Simple and straightforward usage via standard Flutter Image widgets
Includes a variety of currency flag icons
weaknesses: Relies entirely on static PNG asset paths
data.setup_notes: Just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and use Image.asset with the package name.
